title: Textile ETP Chemical Dosing & Parameter Control Matrix

chemicals.purpose: Colloidal color and suspended solids precipitation
chemicals.rule_statement: If raw effluent pH > 8.5, pre-neutralize with acid before alum dosing to prevent hydroxide dissolution.

chemicals.purpose: High-density floc formation with lower sludge volume than Alum
chemicals.rule_statement: Dose PAC directly into flash mixer; superior performance over alum at colder temperatures.

chemicals.purpose: Decolorization of sulfur and reactive dye effluent & Fenton catalyst
chemicals.rule_statement: Must add Lime/Caustic after Ferrous Sulfate to form heavy iron hydroxide precipitate.

chemicals.purpose: Bridging micro-flocs into large, rapidly settling macro-flocs
chemicals.rule_statement: Prepare 0.1% stock solution with aging time of 45 mins. Over-dosing causes floc dispersion and foam.

chemicals.purpose: Generates hydroxyl radicals (•OH) to break down recalcitrant azo dye bonds
chemicals.rule_statement: Dose H2O2 strictly after adjusting pH to 3.2 and adding FeSO4. Quench residual H2O2 prior to bio-stage.
Dose via automated pH feedback controller with acid-resistant PTFE lining and static mixer.

chemicals.purpose: pH elevation, heavy metal precipitation, and sludge conditioning
chemicals.rule_statement: Dose as 5-10% slurry. Lime increases total primary sludge weight but yields dense, fast-dewatering sludge.

chemicals.purpose: Supplies nitrogen and phosphorus for bacterial biomass synthesis
chemicals.rule_statement: Monitor residual N (< 2 mg/L) and P (< 0.5 mg/L) in secondary clarifier overflow to prevent bio-starvation.

chemicals.purpose: Scavenges free chlorine to protect polyamide RO membranes from oxidation
chemicals.rule_statement: Maintain Oxidation-Reduction Potential (ORP) < 200 mV before RO membranes at all times.

chemicals.purpose: Inhibits CaSO4, CaCO3, and Silica scale formation on membrane surface
chemicals.rule_statement: Dose continuously via dosing pump interlocked with high-pressure RO pump. Never run RO without antiscalant.
